artworks.title: Self-Portrait of Joseph Werner
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body and head of a person positioned to the right of the central composition. They are in a semi-profile view, turning slightly towards the viewer. This individual has long, curly hair cascading down to their shoulders and is wearing a cap. Their facial features appear calm. They are dressed in a voluminous draped garment, possibly a robe or a coat with wide sleeves and detailed with fabric folds. In their company is a large lion on which a cherub sits atop, holding a staff. To the left, two other cherubs are present, one of them holding what appears to be a laurel wreath. The setting includes grand architectural elements such as large fluted columns and an elaborate background with edifices resembling classical temples. Lush foliage surrounds the structures. The entire scene is detailed, indicating it may be an engraved artwork.

artworks.title: Satyr and Nymph in a Swamp
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: This image features an etching of an oak tree from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The tree dominates the natural scene, with intricate details in the foliage and bark. The monochromatic color palette ranges from grey to black to create depth and contrast. Two figures are seen in the lower left corner, partially hidden by vegetation. The tree's branches lead the eye towards a softly illuminated sky in the background.

artworks.title: Old Man with an Open Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, waist up, facing slightly to the right. He has distinguishable facial features including a long beard, pronounced eyebrows, a strong nose, and an attentive gaze. His hair is medium-length, partly covered by a headscarf or cap with tassels. He wears a fur-lined garment and an elaborate chain around his shoulders. The man is holding an open book with one hand on the pages. The background is dark and textured, emphasizing the man in the forefront.

artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to block mark): 23.7 x 16.1 cm (9 5/16 x 6 5/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring figures in a natural landscape with intricate line work resembling woodcut prints. In the foreground, three individuals are gathered around a reclining figure. The sitting figure is central, with others showing deep emotion and reverence towards them. The background includes hills, trees, and architectural structures, creating a serene setting. The drawing demonstrates dynamic texture through the use of line and shading.

artworks.title: Portrait of an Old Peasant Woman, in Profile to the Right, and Peasant Woman with Closed Eyes
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image shows two side profile portraits of elderly individuals facing each other. On the left, a man is depicted from the neck up, wearing a dark cap. His face is marked with lines that suggest age, and his gaze is towards the woman on the right. The right portrait presents a woman also shown from the neck up, with her hair pulled back and partially covered. Like the man, her face displays detailed lines and textures emphasizing her age. She is adorned with an earring and wearing a garment fastened with a bow around her neck. The background is plain with no additional elements behind the faces. Both portraits are signed with the name "W. Geets" and dated 1874.

artworks.title: The County Election
artworks.artist: John Sartain after George Caleb Bingham
artworks.medium: hand-colored etching, stipple, line engraving, and mezzotint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The print features a busy outdoor scene with numerous men sitting, standing, and talking in front of a large building. The men are depicted wearing top hats, waistcoats, suspenders, and bow ties, in colors such as dark green, dark blue, red, yellow, and brown, with white shirts. The all have light skin. The men appear to be forming a long line that ends on the right on the porch of a large brown building. The men at the front of the line are all holding slips of paper, and a small blue sign hangs over the porch that reads "THE WILL OF THE PEOPLE THE SUPREME LAW." At the bottom of the print, two boys and a dog are on the dirt ground, and in the bottom left corner a seated man gets a drink from a man in an apron. In the background, there are trees, white buildings, and people on horseback under a partly cloudy blue sky.

artworks.title: Part of the Via Flaminia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a path curving into the scene. Two figures are walking along the path, with another pair further away. Trees line the right side, while various vegetation covers the left side and stretches into the distance. The horizon is obscured by trees and some distant structures. The artwork is done in ink on paper, with intricate line work and a clear sky in the background.

artworks.title: The Pond in the Tuileries
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image shows a park filled with people, viewed from slightly above. Trees, a building with a dome, and figures in warm earthy tones with hints of purple and pink are in the scene. Dynamic brushstrokes emphasize flowing lines. Closest to the viewer are people in elegant attire, some talking or walking. In the background, white sailboats are on a water body.

artworks.title: The Early Ploughman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: This image features a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated point, showcasing a pastoral scene. The horizon is positioned roughly one-third from the top, showcasing a vast sky with textured brushstrokes that may depict rolling clouds. In the background on the horizon, there is a silhouetted castle-like structure. In the foreground, two oxen are seen in motion with a plow, guided by a farmer. To the right, a line of trees creates an enclosed feeling, with a small figure among them. The entire scene is rendered in a monochromatic palette of sepia or brown hues to create a tonal and atmospheric effect.

artworks.title: Rock Oaks
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image shows a dense woodland area with trees filling the frame. There is no visible horizon line, with detailed rocks and foliage in the foreground. The brushstrokes are detailed and resemble etching, creating depth and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and white contrasts to define forms and details of the landscape.

artworks.title: Two Cottages
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image shows an old, thatched-roof cottage. The horizon is positioned just above the roofline. The cottage has two chimneys protruding upwards. The drawing style includes pen strokes, hatching, and cross-hatching for texture and shadows. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on an off-white background. The ground near the cottage is uneven with some indistinct objects, and there is foliage near one of the doors. Faint clouds are sketched in the sky above the roof.

artworks.title: Lion Hunt
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene involving humans and animals. The scene shows warriors on horseback and foot soldiers fighting, with a lion in the center. The composition is dynamic, with figures in various poses conveying motion and tension. Horses have flowing manes and the figures are dressed in classical or ancient attire. The sky is lightly detailed, providing a backdrop for the action in the foreground.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: This is a collection of rough sketches and studies depicting various subjects such as figures, horse outlines, and faces. The drawing is in sepia tones with fine lines defining the sketches. Different elements show varying levels of detail and development. The figures are drawn in different poses and angles, possibly indicating practice in form and anatomy. The surface of the image shows signs of wear and staining.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Man Leading a Horse
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a mix of natural elements and architecture. The view is slightly elevated, showcasing a cluster of buildings including a tower in the distance. The style features detailed linework with cross-hatching for texture. The color scheme is mostly brown and sepia. In the foreground, a man leads a horse on a rocky path, and a seated figure watches nearby. On the right, a group of trees is prominently displayed, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: An Italian Walled Town Seen through Trees
artworks.medium: red chalk on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a building integrated into the natural surroundings. There are trees and bushes surrounding the structure. The horizon is defined by the tree line and the top of the building. A tower or tall structure is visible. The artist used loose brushstrokes to depict the scene with quick, flowing lines. The color palette is sepia, creating a monochromatic effect. In the foreground, there is a path leading towards the center where the building and trees are situated, all under an open sky.

artworks.title: Central Park
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous Gift
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene in a park with groups of figures enjoying the outdoors. The central focus is a large, colorful canopy with long sashes. The scene is lively, with diverse colors and brushstrokes creating a sense of movement and cheerfulness. Other groups and individuals can be seen sitting or watching around the central circle, surrounded by lush greenery. The artist uses pastel tones such as blues, greens, and reds to convey harmony and leisure. The style resembles that of Maurice Prendergast, known for portraying social gatherings with vibrant brushwork and palettes.

artworks.title: Peter Paying the Temple Tax
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three men gathered closely together, with a partial view of a fourth man peering out from a window. The man on the left is bent slightly at the waist, facing the other two men, and is holding a small object in his right hand. His facial features are soft with a gentle expression and his hair is depicted as curly. He wears a long robe with draped folds that cover most of his body, and appears barefoot. The two other men stand closer together. The man in the center has a calm expression with short curly hair and a light beard, and wears a long robe. The third man, positioned on the right, has a more aged appearance with a longer beard, and wears a long robe. Behind them, the fourth man observes from a window or opening in the structure. The setting is under a structure with a tiled roof and a series of columns. In the background, beyond an archway, a landscape with hills is visible, as well as a distant figure sitting on the ground. The composition appears to be a carefully sketched scene with attention to architectural detail and perspective.

artworks.title: Landeskrone Mountain near Görlitz
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene with a valley, mountain, trees, rocks, cultivated fields, and forested areas. The mountain is detailed with etching strokes, showcasing rocky terrain and clustered vegetation near the summit. The artwork utilizes cross-hatching and fine line work to create textures and shades. The color scheme is monochromatic, focusing on light and dark contrasts for depth. Trees, rocks, and various landscapes are seen in the foreground, while a sky with clouds is softly rendered in the background.

artworks.title: Lauban in Silesia
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a black and white etching depicting old buildings surrounded by trees. Steeples and a tower peek above the tree line. The etching technique is detailed with precise lines creating texture. The scene has a monochromatic color palette. The foreground shows grass and bushes, leading to European-style buildings. The sky is mostly clear with faint cloud outlines.

artworks.title: Johann Georg Sulzer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert Paul Mann and Dorothy Neeld Mann
artworks.description: The image is a line drawing of a man in profile, facing to the right. He is seated with his head tilted upwards. The man has a prominent nose, focused eyes, and short, textured hair with curls. He is clean-shaven and wears a collared garment under a textured outer garment. There are no accessories or objects present. The background is plain. An artist's signature, "A. Graff fec," is in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Detmar Friedrich Wilhelm Basse
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert Paul Mann and Dorothy Neeld Mann
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the waist up, with a large hat, curly hair, soft facial features, a neutral expression, a buttoned coat, and a scarf tied in a bow. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Jonah Thrown into the Stormy Sea
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a seascape with a rocky cliff, a tower, stairs leading to the sea, a sailing ship amidst waves, distant edifices including a bridge, turbulent ocean, and stormy sky. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic color palette, emphasizing the foreboding atmosphere. The detailed lines and brushstrokes convey the storm's chaos and architectural majesty.

artworks.title: An Ancient Pine Forest with a Mountain Stream
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over charcoal  on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke

artworks.title: Amsterdam, Ships at the IJ on Choppy Water
artworks.artist: Workshop of Johann Teyler after Johannes van den Aveele (formerly after Jan van Call)
artworks.medium: color etching inked à la poupée on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 37.2 x 52.2 cm (14 5/8 x 20 9/16 in.)
sheet (cut within image): 40.8 x 52.2 cm (16 1/16 x 20 9/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This image depicts a harbor scene with sailing ships. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing a bustling harbor with ships sailing. The horizon is above the middle of the composition, with ships of various sizes and sails unfurled. The style features intricate brushstrokes capturing the sea, ships, and clouds. The color palette includes muted tones like blues and grays for the sky and sea, with hints of warm reds and browns on the ships. Waves in the foreground and textured clouds in the sky add to the dynamic scene.
